answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 114 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a ledge bet on surviving 114 epochs of grading, and every tundra settlement recomputes the umber schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
